researchBoundary.purpose: Owner-review shortlist for the YouNew 90-Day Employee Onboarding Pilot
researchBoundary.personalData: No named individuals, personal email addresses, scraped profiles, or non-public contact data
researchBoundary.qualificationNote: Fit reasons are bounded hypotheses that require owner review and discovery; inclusion is not evidence of interest or purchase intent.

organizations.name: Dwellworks
organizations.fitReason: Operates destination and relocation services and lists a Netherlands presence; a maintained Dutch onboarding hub could complement employee-facing destination support.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Netherlands destination-services or client-solutions lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Jobbatical
organizations.fitReason: Provides immigration and relocation support in the Netherlands; verified practical routes may cover everyday settlement questions outside transaction workflows.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Netherlands relocation operations or partnerships lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Santa Fe Relocation
organizations.fitReason: Maintains an Amsterdam office for relocation services; YouNew could be evaluated as a fixed-scope, source-linked employee navigation layer for one destination.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Amsterdam client-services or destination-services lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Equus Software
organizations.fitReason: Builds global-mobility technology; the pilot could be explored only as complementary employee content, not as a replacement for its mobility platform.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Partner ecosystem or product-solutions lead (role inference)

organizations.name: SIRVA
organizations.fitReason: Runs global-mobility services and a Netherlands mobility forum; one-region practical guidance may be relevant as a controlled content pilot.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: EMEA client-services or destination-solutions lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Crown Relocations Netherlands
organizations.fitReason: Explicitly supports companies moving employees and operates an Amsterdam office; a verified onboarding hub could be tested alongside move-management services.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Netherlands corporate-relocation or client-services lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Settly
organizations.fitReason: Offers relocation and settling-in services; YouNew may be relevant only where its source-linked regional routes add coverage without duplicating Settly's core platform.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Client success, partnerships, or destination-services lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Expat Management Group
organizations.fitReason: Provides immigration and relocation services in the Netherlands; practical navigation could address non-advisory daily-life questions after formal relocation steps.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Relocation services or business-development lead (role inference)

organizations.name: RSH Relocation Services Holland
organizations.fitReason: Provides Dutch relocation support and publicly routes immigration needs to an independent specialist; a verified regional hub could be tested as a bounded, non-advisory employee handoff resource.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Relocation operations or client-services lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Altair Global
organizations.fitReason: Lists a Netherlands office within its global mobility network; localized, versioned employee guidance may warrant a small partner evaluation.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: EMEA client-services or partner-solutions lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Anywr Netherlands (formerly Settle Service)
organizations.fitReason: Offers mobility and talent services in the Netherlands; the pilot could test a branded practical hub for one region without enterprise integration.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Mobility solutions or client-services lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Expat Group
organizations.fitReason: Has a dedicated employer proposition for international employees; YouNew may complement formal services with maintained, source-linked practical routes.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Employer-services or partnerships lead (role inference)

organizations.name: ASML
organizations.fitReason: Publicly documents a comprehensive relocation package for international hires moving to the Netherlands; a regional onboarding hub could be evaluated for practical post-offer questions.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: International mobility, people operations, or onboarding lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Booking.com
organizations.fitReason: Its Amsterdam careers material describes an international headquarters and an expat-partner relocation programme; employee onboarding is visibly relevant.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Global mobility, people experience, or Amsterdam onboarding lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Adyen
organizations.fitReason: Its Amsterdam careers page describes an international environment, more than 80 nationalities, and globally oriented roles; location-aware onboarding may reduce repeated practical questions.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: People operations, workplace experience, or talent mobility lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Philips
organizations.fitReason: Runs Netherlands-focused careers and international mobility programmes; a pilot could be considered for one Dutch employee population after identifying a suitable public business channel.
organizations.contactCaveat: The identified public page routes non-investor matters to company contacts; no suitable onboarding-specific public channel was confirmed.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: International mobility or employee-experience lead (role inference)

organizations.name: TomTom
organizations.fitReason: Its Amsterdam headquarters houses engineering and shared-service teams; international hiring fit is plausible but needs manual qualification before outreach.
organizations.contactCaveat: The reviewed public route is a careers resource; no onboarding-specific public business contact was confirmed.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: People operations, employee experience, or talent lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Mollie
organizations.fitReason: Maintains an Amsterdam headquarters and recruits across multiple European offices; international-onboarding need is plausible but relocation scope was not confirmed on the reviewed official page.
organizations.contactCaveat: No suitable public onboarding or mobility business-contact route was confirmed in this research pass.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: People operations or employee-experience lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Picnic
organizations.fitReason: Its Amsterdam careers site states that colleagues represent more than 80 nationalities and exposes a relocation resource, making practical newcomer onboarding directly relevant.
organizations.contactCaveat: The reviewed public route is a careers resource, not an approved sales or partnership contact channel.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: Relocation, people operations, or employee-experience lead (role inference)

organizations.name: Just Eat Takeaway.com
organizations.fitReason: Its Dutch headquarters hosts People and other international teams in Amsterdam and describes a diverse, international environment; practical onboarding fit requires discovery.
organizations.contactCaveat: The reviewed public route is a careers resource; no onboarding-specific public business contact was confirmed.
organizations.recommendedBuyerRole: People operations, international mobility, or employee-experience lead (role inference)
